mentions.name: Interactive 3D demo of SPDC
mentions.description: An interactive 3D demo of SPDC (spontaneous parametric down-conversion), one of the most common and accessible ways to create entangled pairs of photons. It is part of the author's quantum photonics experiments, which include repeating the Bell inequality tests that won the 2022 Nobel and quantum erasers, with a planned series of articles on learnings from doing quantum photonics in the lab.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just published a fun interactive 3D demo of SPDC, one of the most common and accessible ways to create entangled pairs of photons. I'm hoping to publish a series of articles on other cool learnings about doing quantum photonics in the lab.
